android.desc:
Nomad Camera is a dual camera video recorder that records your front and back camera at the same time, plans your shots for you, and turns one take into ready-to-post videos for Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and more.

NEW: Shot Planner. Type or speak your video idea and get a shot-by-shot plan: what to film, which camera, how long, and a tip for every beat. Then the camera guides you through each shot. 12 creator templates are built in, and you can add your own Gemini API key for AI-written plans.

Record front + rear video with picture-in-picture on supported Android phones, or record one take and export both a 9:16 portrait and a 16:9 landscape video for Reels, Shorts, TikTok, YouTube, ShareChat, Moj and Josh. No second shoot, no cloud editor.

Key features:

- Dual camera video recorder: front and back camera together, with PiP
- Shot Planner: describe a Reel, vlog, product demo or travel video and get a ready-to-shoot shot list
- Guided capture: the camera picks the right lens and walks you through every planned shot
- Quick starts for Reels, products, vlogs, travel, food, fashion, interviews, room tours, tutorials, unboxings, fitness and GRWM
- Optional AI plans with your own Gemini API key
- Drag 9:16 and 16:9 crop frames before recording
- Record once, then export portrait and landscape MP4 videos
- Front + Rear camera recording on supported phones
- Picture-in-picture and separate Front + Rear exports
- Dual shot workflow for reaction videos, interviews, vlogs, tutorials, and product demos
- Auto-Track to keep the largest detected face centered in both crop frames
- Smart teleprompter with reusable scripts, hooks, reviews, and CTA templates
- Creator presets for Reels + YouTube, talking head, reviews, products, podcasts, and custom shoots
- Safe-zone overlays for Reels, Shorts, TikTok, ShareChat, Moj, and Josh
- Pause and resume recording on supported devices
- 24, 30, and 60 fps requests where your phone supports them
- H.264 MP4 export, with HEVC available on supported devices
- Optional logo, intro, outro, background, and beauty export tools
- Session thumbnails, notes, favorites, sharing, and frame grabs
- Local saving to Movies/NomadCamera or app storage

Why creators use this dual camera app:

- Vloggers can capture themselves and the scene in one front + rear camera setup.
- Influencers can record once and post vertical and horizontal versions.
- Reviewers can keep product footage and face reactions together
